specName: Restore From Backup During First-Run Setup
last_action: Phase 4 US2 complete - T021-T027 + T040 done; full rebuild 0 warnings, 2155 tests pass; Phases 5 6 7 remain

FR-001.title: First-run flow presents a checkbox to restore from backup instead of manual setup, before any data entry

FR-002.title: User can choose a backup file from a location of their choosing

FR-003.title: Validate the file and show a contents summary (counts, date, app version) with confirm/cancel before any DB change

FR-004.title: Reject unreadable/corrupt/incompatible backups with a clear message and no DB change

FR-005.title: Confirmed first-run restore replaces DB contents all-or-nothing; partial failure leaves pre-restore state

FR-006.title: After a successful first-run restore, setup is treated as complete with no further config required

FR-007.title: After restore, advise a restart is needed and do not continue on pre-restore in-memory state

FR-008.title: On cancel or failure, the normal setup wizard is available with no data changed

FR-009.title: Users can create a backup choosing both destination location and filename

FR-010.title: Default backup filename = organisation name + the word backup + backup date, always a valid filename

FR-011.title: Backup contains all data needed to reconstruct current state incl. journal entries, bank reconciliations/lines, and archived rows

FR-012.title: Backup captures every configured setting incl. currency, language, FY start, tax applicability/rate/codes, tax-entry mode

FR-013.title: Backup file is OS-independent: created on any supported platform restores identically on any other

FR-014.title: Backup/restore independent of host locale, culture, separators, calendar, time zone

FR-015.title: Every restore first retains a pre-restore recovery copy (first-run: of the seeded default DB)

FR-016.title: Restore reproduces the source dataset exactly (records, values, archived state, counts)

FR-017.title: Creating and restoring a backup are each recorded in the audit trail

FR-018.title: Settings backup/restore screen uses the same default-filename rule, restart advice and post-backup verification as the first-run flow

FR-019.title: Older backups migrate forward on restore; newer incompatible backups (incl. newer same-major build) are rejected outright

FR-020.title: Backup file is unencrypted and never password-protected; user is shown a notice it holds personal + financial data

FR-021.title: Immediately after writing a backup file, read it back from disk before reporting success

FR-022.title: Recompute the restore-confirmation statistics from the read-back file and verify counts against live data (archived included) and the file's own counts

FR-023.title: Report the backup as failed and warn the user if the file is unreadable, internally inconsistent, or its counts do not match the source

FR-024.title: Report a backup as successful only after read-back and verification pass

context: living spec: app-host (first-run routing, setup wizard, startup-error priority)
living spec: data-access (BackupRepository, IgnoreQueryFilters snapshot, PK-upsert restore)
area: existing backup feature — BackupService/.sfbak protobuf envelope, BackupRestoreTab in Settings
constraint: extend the existing capability, do not replace it; restore-in-first-run only while setup incomplete
refinement: post-backup self-check — read the written file back and verify its restore-confirmation stats against live data (FR-021..FR-024, SC-009)
intent: Let a fresh install be populated from a backup during first-run setup, with a complete, OS-agnostic backup and a user-chosen backup file name/location
expectations: Restoring over an already-configured database stays a Settings-only action (not added to first-run)
The application does not self-relaunch; the user is advised to restart manually
No change to the underlying .sfbak serialization technology or to GL/tax structures
Backup encryption/password-protection is not decided here (deferred to clarify, FR-020)
approach: Extend the existing BackupService/BackupRepository/BackupEnvelope .sfbak pipeline rather than replacing it. Add a dedicated pre-wizard screen /first-run-restore (after /language-select, before /setup) with the FR-001 checkbox, reusing Blazor <InputFile> for file selection and a terminal /restart-required screen for FR-007. Bring the backup format up to the data model (3 finance record types + 12 Settings fields + Fee.TaxCode / Transaction.TaxCode / Transaction.JournalEntryId) via append-only protobuf members, schema 1.1.0 to 1.2.0, keeping older files restorable. Add post-write read-back verification (FR-021-024) throwing BackupVerificationException, a full semver version comparison (reject newer incl. same-major), a native Save dialog via CommunityToolkit.Maui FileSaver behind IBackupDestinationPicker, a stable recovery-copy location via IRecoveryCopyStore, and a cross-platform/cross-locale round-trip test.

decisions.decision: Add CommunityToolkit.Maui and use FileSaver behind a Core IBackupDestinationPicker seam for the native Save dialog
decisions.why: The app has no save-dialog mechanism today (backups dump to My Documents); MAUI Essentials has no save picker; FileSaver is the standard cross-platform (Windows+MacCatalyst) answer and pre-fills the dialog name, matching FR-010
decisions.rejected: Hand-rolled per-platform pickers (WinRT FileSavePicker HWND interop + Mac UIDocumentPickerViewController) - more code, more #if branching, no extra capability

decisions.decision: New /first-run-restore is always the first-run gateway to /setup; App.razor.cs targets /language-select or /first-run-restore, never /setup directly
decisions.why: Spec Assumptions require a dedicated pre-wizard restore screen matching spec 029s pattern; routing through it on every first run keeps the restore option reachable even on a relaunch that chose a language but never finished setup
decisions.rejected: Putting the checkbox on FirstRunLanguageScreen - mixes two unrelated decisions and tangles that screens debug-seed branch

decisions.decision: New protobuf members are append-only (envelope 24/25/26; SettingsBackupDto 10,19-29; Fee 10; Transaction 12/13); schema 1.1.0 to 1.2.0; the 3 new collection keys are NOT added to the completeness gate
decisions.why: Older .sfbak files must still restore (FR-019 older-version-accepted); absent collections already normalise to empty and settings fall back to entity defaults
decisions.rejected: Adding new keys to ValidateCompleteness - would make every existing backup fail to restore

decisions.decision: BackupService does the FR-021-024 read-back verification itself right after write, throwing BackupVerificationException on any count/readability failure and leaving the file on disk
decisions.why: One code path computes the restore-confirmation counts and the post-write-check counts, so the numbers a treasurer sees at handover are provably what a restore will show; exception matches the ImportException idiom
decisions.rejected: File hashing - proves byte-stability but not semantic count correctness or that the file is readable as a backup

decisions.decision: Version check becomes a full semver comparison against a compiled BackupSchema.CurrentSchemaVersion constant; reject any file newer on any component (incl. newer same-major build), accept equal-or-older
decisions.why: Clarification widened rejection to newer same-major builds; a compiled constant keeps the check deterministic and host-independent (FR-013/14) and unit-testable without a MAUI runtime
decisions.rejected: Comparing marketing ApplicationVersion (a hardcoded display placeholder) or keeping the major-only check (fails clarified FR-019)

decisions.decision: FirstRunRestoreScreen renders #continue-setup whenever no manifest is loaded (checkbox off, or on with no/errored file) and swaps it for #confirm-restore/#cancel-restore only once a valid manifest is read
decisions.why: keeps the manual path available after a corrupt/newer-version error (T018 "still available") without duplicating the button markup
decisions.rejected: rendering #continue-setup only in the checkbox-off branch — hides it on the error path

decisions.decision: .first-run-restore-progress is a plain spinner + static message, not a Progress<string> feed
decisions.why: IBackupService.ImportAsync exposes no progress callback and T018 is scoped to the two screen files (no interface change); it mirrors the setup-seeding-overlay structure
decisions.rejected: adding an IProgress<string> overload to ImportAsync — out of scope, touches the interface and every implementer/test

decisions.decision: T015 asserts the routing signal via SettingsRepository.GetAsync(...) is not null rather than building the full SetupService graph
decisions.why: that null-check is the exact test ISetupService.IsSetupCompleteAsync and App.razor.cs perform; SetupService has 8 constructor deps
decisions.rejected: wiring the whole SetupService object graph for one boolean

decisions.decision: VerifyWrittenFile is one helper shared by CreateBackupAsync and ExportAsync; the file-vs-actual recompute check covers only the 17 top-level serialised collections, not the 3 nested/derived EntityCounts keys
decisions.why: An EventType with no events is not serialised into the sfbak (only embedded inside an EventBackupDto), so recomputing EventTypes from the read-back would legitimately differ from the stored count and fail an otherwise-valid backup. Source-vs-file still compares every key.
decisions.rejected: Recomputing every EntityCounts key on read-back - false verification failures for orgs with an orphan event type

decisions.decision: BackupVerificationException.Message is a plain English diagnostic string, not routed through ILocalizer
decisions.why: The UI never renders ex.Message (it renders Settings_Backup_VerifyFailed + ex.Discrepancies); discrepancy strings follow the established English-diagnostic detail pattern; the Us2 literal-exception guard regex does not cover BackupVerificationException
decisions.rejected: A ValidationResource key + 7 culture translations for a message no user sees

decisions.decision: T040 SettingsBackupJourneyTests is a service+DB integration test (real BackupService + real SQLite + fake IBackupDestinationPicker), not a bUnit component render
decisions.why: Integration.Tests has no bUnit dependency and its journey tests are service-level by convention; the .backup-verify-result markup and /restart-required navigation are covered by the bUnit T024 BackupRestoreTabTests
decisions.rejected: Adding bUnit to the previously bUnit-free Integration.Tests project for one test

plan.summary: Plan + research + data-model + 4 contracts written for first-run restore, verified backup with native Save dialog, and .sfbak completeness/portability (schema 1.2.0); Constitution Check all PASS
plan.key_finding: The .sfbak format has drifted further than the spec Background states: beyond the 3 finance record types and 12 Settings fields, Fee.TaxCode, Transaction.TaxCode and Transaction.JournalEntryId are also missing from their backup DTOs - silent financial data loss on every current restore, so the plan adds a reflection-based entity-vs-DTO field-parity guard test (SC-008)
